method: Independent stdout parsing, full 12-block matrix/order and identity checks, all accepted raw processes used; paired-block median bootstrap with 10000 draws, seed 61432, percentile indices 250/9750. Summary tolerances rel=1e-11 abs=1e-8.

excluded_retained_cohorts.excluded_note:
This incomplete cold cohort is excluded from performance conclusions.

The build-process idle guard stopped the run after reporting eight complete
paired blocks when PID 67795 matched a compiler/build process name. A follow-up
names-only check found that process had exited. Its origin was not inspected.
The replacement cold-genericrestore-clean cohort starts fresh; no partial
observations from this run are incorporated into its report.

This incomplete second cold cohort is excluded from performance conclusions.

The build-process idle guard stopped after reporting two complete paired blocks
when PIDs 73662 and 73667 matched compiler/build process names. Follow-up
names-only inspection found both had exited. No origin or process arguments
were inspected. Repeated external build interference paused further timings.
These observations will not be merged into a replacement cohort.

This incomplete fourth cold cohort is excluded from performance conclusions.

After 120 uninterrupted idle seconds and five reported complete paired blocks,
the guard recorded Cargo PID 67096, family build, parent /bin/zsh, at
2026-10-03T12:40:26.385174 UTC. Exact family/name evidence is in ABORT.json.
No command arguments or environment were persisted. Recurring external actual
builds prevented this fresh cohort completing; no observations are merged into
any later replacement cohort.

This incomplete third cold cohort is excluded from performance conclusions.

After a 45-second idle interval and four reported complete paired blocks, the
name guard captured PID 89331 as Cargo at 2026-10-03T12:24:06.698490 UTC. The
exact names-only result is retained in ABORT.json. No process arguments were
inspected. Recurring external Cargo activity paused timing again. These partial
observations are not merged into a replacement cohort.

limitations: Process stdout contains its aggregate timing metrics, not every individually timed frame/sample. Scene sequence sums include all emitted measured phases (65 demo/88 text frames) and exclude 119 unreported priming frames. Intervals are exploratory, without multiplicity correction; one machine, CPU drawing/flush only.
